verifications.claim: The Oscars are held at the Dolby Theatre in Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland) on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Dolby Theatre ... is a live-performance auditorium in the Ovation Hollywood shopping mall and entertainment complex, on Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, in the Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States. Since its opening on November 9, 2001, it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony.' R2: 'The 98th Academy Awards will be held on Mar. 15, 2026 at the Dolby Theatre.' R3: 'Dolby Theatre® has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states location, complex name, and Oscars hosting.

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre has hosted the annual Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Since its opening on November 9, 2001, it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony.' R3: 'Dolby Theatre® has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001.'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states hosting since 2001, though first ceremony was 2002; phrasing matches claim.

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is contracted to host the annual Academy Awards ceremony through 2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Dolby Theatre is proud to be home to the highest honor in filmmaking through the year 2028.'

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is located at Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, Hollywood, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, in the Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, California'

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is a purpose-built venue for the Academy Awards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The theater was designed by David Rockwell ... specifically with the Oscar ceremonies in mind.' 'The theater was developed by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) to overcome logistical issues it faced hosting the Academy Awards at other venues'

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre hosts other premier live events.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Besides the Academy Awards, the venue has hosted other concerts and theatrical performances.' Lists American Idol, America's Got Talent, etc.

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is adjacent to the historic TCL Chinese Theatre.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'It is adjacent to the TCL Chinese Theatre'

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is surrounded by the Ovation Hollywood shopping center.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'in the Ovation Hollywood shopping mall and entertainment complex' 'the front facade of the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood, the actual theatre is at the rear of the complex.'
verifications.reasoning: Describes theatre within/at rear of complex, supporting 'surrounded by'.

verifications.claim: The Academy Awards ceremony occasionally takes place at other venues in Los Angeles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'with the only exception being the 93rd Academy Awards in 2021—which were downsized and moved to Union Station' R2: Lists multiple historic venues like Shrine Auditorium, Dorothy Chandler Pavilion, Union Station.
verifications.reasoning: Confirms exceptions and historical other venues in LA.

verifications.claim: The Dolby Theatre is considered the primary, consistent home of the Oscars.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony' since 2001 (one exception). R3: 'home to the highest honor in filmmaking'
verifications.reasoning: Described as main venue since 2001 with minimal exceptions.

verifications.claim: Ovation Hollywood was formerly Hollywood & Highland
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: References 'Ovation Hollywood shopping mall' and earlier 'Hollywood and Highland Center' in context of venue naming changes.
verifications.reasoning: Directly implies name change from Hollywood & Highland to Ovation Hollywood.
